candidates.change_summary: Change the modulo divisor from 2 to 1 so random is always 0, guaranteeing the transfer/reset branch executes every call.
Replace the condition with false so the payout/reset is never executed, leaving pot to accumulate.
Delete the condition body so pot is never reset, accumulating across plays.
Delete the `pot = 0` assignment so pot is never reset after a win.
Replace `pot = 0` with `pot = 1` so pot retains a non-zero value after a win.
Delete the `pot += msg.value` line so pot remains unchanged despite play.
Change `pot += msg.value` to `pot += 1` so pot increases by 1 instead of the sent value.
Insert a second `pot += msg.value` before the random computation, doubling the pot increment per play.
Change the require to check against 0 ether so play succeeds without sending any value, leaving pot unchanged from input but altering later logic.
